tax.text: He said he supports lower taxes, responsible spending, and letting families keep more of what they earn.
tax.quote: Job creators and low income families both need tax relief, not a bigger federal tax burden. I support lower taxes, responsible spending, and policies that let all families keep more of what they earn.

immigration.text: He said immigration laws should be enforced and local governments should cooperate with federal authorities.
immigration.quote: Immigration laws should always be enforced, and local governments must cooperate with federal authorities to protect citizens.

guns.text: He said public safety should focus on prosecuting violent criminals and keeping guns from violent felons, rather than restricting responsible gun owners.
guns.quote: Public safety should focus on prosecuting violent criminals, improving mental health resources, and keeping firearms out of the hands of convicted violent felons - not restricting the rights of responsible gun owners.

abortion.text: He said elective abortions should not be allowed and that unborn children deserve legal protection.
abortion.quote: I believe elective abortions should not be allowed. Human life is sacred and deserves protection, especially unborn children.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He said males should not compete in women's sports or occupy spaces reserved for women.
gender.quote: Women and girls deserve privacy, safety, and fair competition. Males should not compete in women’s sports or occupy spaces reserved for women.

health.text: He said Medicare and Medicaid should remain available while opposing federal takeover and supporting competition and patient choice.
health.quote: Medicare and Medicaid should remain available for seniors and the truly vulnerable, but Washington should not ever take over health care. I support patient choice, price transparency, competition, and lower costs through free-market reforms.

energy.text: He said American oil and gas is the most reliable electricity source and opposed subsidizing renewable energy.
energy.quote: American oil and gas is the most reliable energy source. We should not subsidize so called "renewable" energy sources that cannot stand on their own two feet.

voting.text: He opposed voting without photo identification and described photo ID as a safeguard for election integrity.
voting.quote: Photo ID is a commonsense safeguard that helps protect election integrity and public confidence in our voting system.

trade.text: He criticized tariffs in connection with rising food prices.
trade.quote: Has Kevin Hern done anything to stop the tariffs? I haven’t seen anything,

debt.text: He said a permanent solution to Social Security’s funding issues should preserve benefits for future generations.
debt.quote: We must seek a solution that is bipartisan, efficient, and permanent so our children will receive the same or better benefits as we do or our parents.

housing.text: He called for affordable housing construction, including more homes and rental units.
housing.quote: We need 14,000 affordable housing units just in Tulsa, and millions more around the country

schools.text: He supports investing in public schools and opposes sending public money to private schools without accountability requirements.
schools.quote: stopping the flow of public money to private schools with no strings attached.

immigration.text: He supports border security and accountability for lawbreaking while also calling for a citizenship path for long-term residents and redirecting ICE resources to immigration courts.
immigration.quote: I believe in a secure border and that people who are actively breaking the law should be held accountable in order to keep our communities safe. I also believe in treating people with dignity. Long-term residents who pay taxes, contribute to their communities, and have built their lives here should have a real, accessible path to citizenship

health.text: He supports expanding health coverage through Medicaid, ACA subsidies, or a broader universal coverage model.
health.quote: I support expanding access through Medicaid expansion, ACA subsidies, or a broader universal coverage model.
